presentation.name: Bitmaxing
presentation.subtitle: Human in command
presentation.revision: The Drummer front door with Bit turned all the way up: redrawn, awake, watching the pointer, and the maps redrawn around it.

statement: V44 Bitmaxing gives the Drummer front door, a live transit gate and seven stations in the platinum cAshIo identity, a redrawn and livelier Bit and redrawn maps. The gate is generative artwork. The helm and E.V.E. are scripted browser experiences that send no requests. Observation records and historical releases retain their original dates, versions and limits.
